resourceTypes.description: An Astro account. The root of product authorization.
A packaged agent that can be deployed.
A named list of people who may talk to an agent.
A connected or managed data store an agent reads.

permissions.name: Read account
permissions.description: View the account's name, avatar, profile, and experiments.

permissions.name: Edit account
permissions.description: Change the account's name, avatar, profile, and experiments.

permissions.name: Delete account
permissions.description: Delete the account.

permissions.name: Read members
permissions.description: View members and invitations.

permissions.name: Manage members
permissions.description: Invite members, remove them, and change their roles.

permissions.name: Read groups
permissions.description: View groups and their membership.

permissions.name: Manage groups
permissions.description: Create, rename, and delete groups, and change their membership.

permissions.name: Read apps
permissions.description: View machine apps and their scopes.

permissions.name: Manage apps
permissions.description: Create and delete machine apps, their scopes, and their secrets.

permissions.name: Read data sources
permissions.description: View data sources and their exclusion lists.

permissions.name: Manage data sources
permissions.description: Create, rename, and revoke data sources, and edit their exclusion lists.

permissions.name: Read Insights summary
permissions.description: View the account's aggregate coding-tool activity and your own.

permissions.name: Read member Insights
permissions.description: View each member's coding-tool activity.

permissions.name: Read billing
permissions.description: View usage, invoices, balances, and spend thresholds.

permissions.name: Manage billing
permissions.description: Set spend thresholds and manage the payment method.

permissions.name: Read audit log
permissions.description: View the account audit log.

permissions.name: Read integrations
permissions.description: View GitHub, Slack, and Supabase connections.

permissions.name: Manage integrations
permissions.description: Connect and disconnect GitHub, Slack, and Supabase.

permissions.name: Read clusters
permissions.description: View the clusters assigned to the account.

permissions.name: Create blueprints
permissions.description: Create blueprints in the account.

permissions.name: Create deployments
permissions.description: Deploy agents in the account.

permissions.name: Create variables
permissions.description: Create account variables.

permissions.name: Create audiences
permissions.description: Create audiences.

permissions.name: Create knowledge stores
permissions.description: Connect or provision knowledge stores.

permissions.name: Read blueprint
permissions.description: View the blueprint, its versions, and its builds.

permissions.name: Edit blueprint
permissions.description: Change the blueprint's content, avatar, and README.

permissions.name: Operate blueprint
permissions.description: Trigger a rebuild and manage the blueprint's GitHub link.

permissions.name: Delete blueprint
permissions.description: Archive the blueprint.

permissions.name: Manage blueprint access
permissions.description: Grant and revoke access to the blueprint, and set whether it is public.

permissions.name: Transfer blueprint
permissions.description: Move the blueprint to another account.

permissions.name: Read deployment
permissions.description: View the deployment, its configuration, logs, traces, files, and chat history. Secret values stay redacted.

permissions.name: Edit deployment
permissions.description: Change the deployment's configuration and metadata.

permissions.name: Operate deployment
permissions.description: Redeploy, roll back, restart, stop, resume, cancel, and trigger ingestion.

permissions.name: Delete deployment
permissions.description: Undeploy the deployment.

permissions.name: Manage deployment access
permissions.description: Grant and revoke access to the deployment.

permissions.name: Read variable
permissions.description: View the variable's name, description, and plaintext value. A secret's value is never returned.

permissions.name: Edit variable
permissions.description: Change the variable's value and description.

permissions.name: Delete variable
permissions.description: Delete the variable.

permissions.name: Manage variable access
permissions.description: Grant and revoke access to the variable.

permissions.name: Read audience
permissions.description: View the audience and its members.

permissions.name: Edit audience
permissions.description: Rename the audience and change its description.

permissions.name: Manage audience members
permissions.description: Add and remove audience members.

permissions.name: Delete audience
permissions.description: Delete the audience.

permissions.name: Manage audience access
permissions.description: Grant and revoke access to the audience.

permissions.name: Read knowledge store
permissions.description: View the knowledge store and its connection details.

permissions.name: Edit knowledge store
permissions.description: Change the knowledge store's credentials and settings.

permissions.name: Operate knowledge store
permissions.description: Recheck the knowledge store's connection and repair its host.

permissions.name: Delete knowledge store
permissions.description: Delete the knowledge store.

permissions.name: Manage knowledge store access
permissions.description: Grant and revoke access to the knowledge store.

roles.name: Member
roles.description: Belongs to the account. Sees no resource unless granted one directly.

roles.name: Maintainer
roles.description: Runs the account without gaining access to the work inside it.

roles.name: Admin
roles.description: Full control of the account and every resource in it.

roles.name: Viewer
roles.description: Reads the blueprint.

roles.name: Writer
roles.description: Reads and changes the blueprint.

roles.name: Maintainer
roles.description: Also rebuilds it and manages its GitHub link.

roles.name: Admin
roles.description: Full control, including deletion, transfer, and access.

roles.name: Viewer
roles.description: Reads the deployment.

roles.name: Writer
roles.description: Reads and changes the deployment.

roles.name: Maintainer
roles.description: Also redeploys, rolls back, restarts, and stops it.

roles.name: Admin
roles.description: Full control, including deletion and access.

roles.name: Viewer
roles.description: Reads the variable.

roles.name: Writer
roles.description: Reads and changes the variable.

roles.name: Admin
roles.description: Full control, including deletion and access.

roles.name: Viewer
roles.description: Reads the audience and its members.

roles.name: Writer
roles.description: Also renames the audience.

roles.name: Maintainer
roles.description: Also adds and removes members.

roles.name: Admin
roles.description: Full control, including deletion and access.

roles.name: Viewer
roles.description: Reads the knowledge store.

roles.name: Writer
roles.description: Reads and changes the knowledge store.

roles.name: Maintainer
roles.description: Also rechecks its connection.

roles.name: Admin
roles.description: Full control, including deletion and access.
